System-wide /etc/ld.so.conf.d/10-rocm-opencl.conf registers /opt/rocm-7.2.1/lib.
remediation: patchelf 0.19.1 prepended venv-SDK RUNPATH ($ORIGIN-relative) on torch libs where patchelf succeeded (libaotriton_v2, libc10_hip, libcaffe2_nvrtc, libtorch_cpu, libtorch_python)

libtorch_hip.so and libtorch_rocshmem.so rejected patchelf ('section content is not naturally aligned'); instead soname symlinks for all 8 needed ROCm sonames (libMIOpen.so.1, libamdhip64.so.7, libhipblas.so.3, libhipblaslt.so.1, libhiprtc.so.7, libhsa-runtime64.so.1, librccl.so.1, librocblas.so.5) were placed in torch/lib; RUNPATH $ORIGIN is searched first for libtorch_hip.so
note: LD_LIBRARY_PATH still takes precedence over RUNPATH for RUNPATH-type binaries, so per-leg source-built MIOpen directories will win during A/B validation
